messages.subject: Legends for geom_hilight
parts:
Hello there!

How do we add legends corresponding to colors of overlapped geom_hilight geometries? I'm hoping to automade adding legends to a ggtree as below:

###################################################################

library(ape)
library(ggtree)

set.seed(1)

tree <- rtree(10)
nds <- c(12,14,16)
cls <- c('blue','red','green')
alphas <- c(0.8,0.7,0.3)
names <- c('Clade 1','Clade 2','Clade 3')

gg <- ggtree(tree)
for (i in 1:3){
  gg <- gg+geom_hilight(nds[i],cls[i],alpha = alphas[i])
}
gg

###################################################################

I'd like a legend that has, for each element of "names", a box with the correct color of the geom_hilight. Is that possible?

Thanks again! ggtree is an incredible resource - looking forward to using it some more!

Best,
Alex
